name: helpdesk_motive
summary: Adds a Motive field to helpdesk tickets so agents can record why a ticket was opened. The motive list is set up per team, so each team only sees the reasons relevant to it. Motives are managed under Helpdesk > Configuration > Motives.

name: helpdesk_portal_priority
summary: Lets customers choose a priority when they open a ticket through the helpdesk customer portal. The chosen priority is then set on the ticket in the back office. It appears on the portal ticket creation form.

name: helpdesk_portal_restriction
summary: Restricts which helpdesk teams and ticket categories each customer can open tickets for. It is set on the customer's contact form. Customers then only see the allowed options when submitting a ticket in the portal.

name: helpdesk_product
summary: Adds a Product field to helpdesk tickets so a ticket can be tied to the product it concerns. Products also get a smart count of related tickets, so you can see all support tickets for a product from its form. It shows on the ticket form and on product forms.

name: helpdesk_ticket_close_inactive
summary: Automatically closes helpdesk tickets that have had no activity for a set number of days, configured per team. Before closing, it can send a warning email to the customer and team members, and a final closing email when the limit is reached. Settings are on the Helpdesk team form under Settings > Teams.

name: helpdesk_ticket_open_tab
summary: Adds a button on Helpdesk kanban cards that opens a ticket in a new browser tab. Agents can keep the team board open while working on a ticket. It is found in the Helpdesk team kanban view.

name: helpdesk_ticket_partner_response
summary: Automatically moves a helpdesk ticket to another stage when the customer replies, whether through the portal or by email. On the team settings you choose which stage a ticket must be in and which stage it moves to. This is useful when a ticket waiting on the customer should be flagged as answered.

name: helpdesk_ticket_related
summary: Lets you link helpdesk tickets to each other, for example a follow-up or a duplicate ticket. The Related tickets field on the ticket form shows the linked tickets, giving a fuller history of a customer issue.

name: helpdesk_timesheet_time_type
summary: Shows the Time Type field from timesheets on the time tracking tab of helpdesk tickets. This lets agents classify the time they spend on a ticket by type. It is a small bridge between helpdesk timesheets and time types.

name: helpdesk_type
summary: Adds a Type field to helpdesk tickets, with a list you maintain under Helpdesk Configuration. Types can be limited to specific teams and can optionally be shown on the customer portal form, where they can also be made required.

name: helpdesk_type_sla
summary: Lets an SLA policy in the Helpdesk SLA module apply only to chosen ticket types. Set it on the SLA policy form, so each ticket type can follow its own service targets.

name: website_helpdesk_mgmt
summary: Connects a website form to helpdesk so that submitting it creates a helpdesk ticket. Customers can open a support request from the public website without logging in. It is a bridge between the website and helpdesk.

name: hr_holidays_calendar_planning
summary: Makes Time Off work together with employee calendar planning and flexible hours. It is a bridge module, so you only need it if you use flexible hours with time off. It adds no new fields of its own.

name: hr_holidays_leave_repeated
summary: Lets an employee create repeating time off, such as the same leave every week for a number of times or until an end date. Repeat settings are on the Time Off request form, and the leave type must have Repeat turned on in its configuration. Each repetition is created as its own request when saved.

name: hr_holidays_leave_report_calendar_type
summary: Adds a Leave Type filter to the Time Off Overview calendar, both in the side filter panel and in the search bar. This lets managers view the calendar for just one kind of leave. It is found under Time Off > Overview.

name: hr_holidays_natural_period
summary: Adds Natural day and Natural day (Half Day) options to the request unit of a leave type, so a leave can be counted in calendar days. The request unit is set on the leave type and the allocation. Leave requests then use it from the Time Off dashboard.

name: hr_holidays_public
summary: Manages public holidays in Time Off so they are not counted as leave days when the leave type excludes them. Public holidays are entered under Calendar > Configuration > Public Holidays and show as grey days on the calendar. Exclusion is turned on per leave type under Time Off > Configuration > Time Off Types.

name: hr_holidays_public_city
summary: Adds cities to public holiday lines, so a holiday can apply only to specific cities instead of a whole country or state. This is useful when local holidays differ by city. It is set on the public holiday lines in Calendar configuration.

name: hr_holidays_settings
summary: Adds an empty Settings form under Leaves > Configuration > Settings. It holds no options itself, but gives other modules a place to add their time off settings. This is a technical base module.

name: resource_calendar_flexible_exclude_weekend
summary: Adds an option on working schedules (resource calendars) that leaves weekend days out of flexible hours calculations. Set it on the working schedule form when the company uses flexible hours. It is a technical setting used with flexible schedules.

name: resource_leaves_geographic
summary: Lets public holidays be limited to a state, so a local holiday applies only to employees in that region. Holidays without a state apply to everyone. Local holidays show with a grey background on the Time Off overview for the matching employees.

name: base_search_mail_content
summary: Adds a Message Content search field to any record with a chatter, so you can find records by what was written in their messages. Searches cover the subject, body, sender, reply-to and record name. It is most useful on helpdesk tickets and project issues that have long conversations.

name: base_user_signature
summary: Adds a Signature image field to user records, so each user can store a digital signature. It is set under Settings > Users & Companies > Users on the user form. This is a technical base module that other documents can use.

name: fetchmail_incoming_test
summary: Lets administrators test incoming email without a real mail server. A Simulate Incoming Email button on the Incoming Mail Server form opens a composer, and the message is routed like a fetched email, creating the target record such as a helpdesk ticket. A Replay Email File option feeds in a saved .eml file to reproduce how a message was handled.

name: mail_activity_board
summary: Adds an Activity Board with list, kanban, calendar, pivot and graph views to see planned activities in one place. A smart button on records shows their activities, and each activity links back to the record it came from. The board is found under the Boards menu.

name: mail_activity_dashboard
summary: Adds a link to the Activity Board in the Dashboards menu, so activity planning can be viewed alongside other dashboards. It is a technical bridge that needs the activity board and spreadsheet dashboard modules installed.

name: mail_activity_done
summary: Keeps completed activities as Done records instead of deleting them, so they can be reported on later. It switches this option on for all existing and new activity types. Since Odoo 18 this is native, so the module mainly makes sure the setting is on everywhere.

name: mail_activity_plan_domain
summary: Restricts activity plans and their individual steps to records that match a domain condition. A plan can appear only for certain partners, and a step is skipped for records it does not fit. The Domain field is on the activity plan and plan line forms under Settings > Technical > Activities.

name: mail_activity_reminder
summary: Sends reminder notifications before or on the deadline of planned activities. Reminder days are set per activity type, such as 0 for the deadline day and 5 for five days before. It is configured under Settings > Technical > Activity Types.

name: mail_activity_team
summary: Lets activities be assigned to a team instead of just one person. Teams have members and a leader, and activities can be routed to a team's members. Teams are set up under Settings > Technical > Discuss > Activity Teams, and users are added in their preferences.

name: mail_attach_existing_attachment
summary: When sending a record by email, you can pick attachments already stored on that record. Files are first added with a log note, then selected in the mail composer. This saves re-uploading documents that are already on the record.

name: mail_attach_existing_attachment_account
summary: Brings the existing-attachment picker to the invoice and document sending wizard in Accounting. You can choose files already on an invoice when emailing it to a customer. It requires the base existing attachment module.

name: mail_autogenerated_header
summary: Marks Odoo outgoing emails as automatically generated, so receiving mail servers do not send vacation auto-replies. It also drops auto-generated incoming emails, which prevents mail loops. Outgoing marking can be turned off with a system parameter. This is a technical email setting.

name: mail_autosubscribe
summary: Automatically adds selected contacts as followers on their company's business documents, such as invoices. For example, an accountant can be copied on every invoice for a customer. You set the models under Configuration > Technical > Automation > Autosubscribe Models and tick In copy of on the partner.

name: mail_composer_cc_bcc
summary: Adds separate Cc and Bcc fields to the mail composer, which Odoo otherwise lacks. Default Cc and Bcc contacts can be set on the company form, and Bcc can be set on mail templates. Each recipient gets their own email, with the same To, Cc and Bcc headers.

name: mail_composer_cc_bcc_mail_tracking
summary: Shows Cc and Bcc recipients in the chatter for each sent email, next to the To line. The recipient list can be expanded into To, Cc and Bcc groups, and settings choose the default view and whether users can toggle it. It needs both the Cc and Bcc and email tracking modules.

name: mail_debrand
summary: Removes Odoo branding from outgoing emails, including the Powered by Odoo footer and links. Once installed, it applies to all emails sent. Use it so customers do not see the Odoo name in emails.

name: mail_drop_target
summary: Lets you drag an email file from your desktop onto a record's chatter to attach it there. It supports .eml files, and .msg files if an extra library is installed. Followers are notified about the new message, and that notification can be turned off in settings.

name: mail_extra_header
summary: Adds an Extra Headers field to outgoing mail servers, so custom headers can be added to all emails sent through that server. The field takes a dictionary of header names and values. It is set on the outgoing mail server form.

name: mail_force_email_notification
summary: Forces specific chatter notifications to be sent by email, even to users who are connected to Odoo. It works through a context key that developers set when posting messages. End users see no change, so this is a developer feature.

name: mail_forward
summary: Lets a user forward a message from any record's chatter to other users or to another record. Forwarding to users adds them as followers without notifying the existing followers. A Forward icon appears on chatter messages, and models must be enabled for forwarding under Settings > Technical.

name: mail_inline_css
summary: Converts style blocks in email templates into inline styles, so they display correctly in mail clients. It applies the same processing the web editor uses for templates stored in the database. This is a technical helper with no visible screens.

name: mail_layout_force
summary: Forces a specific email layout on chosen email templates, replacing the standard Odoo layout. You can also force a no-layout option or a custom one for emails sent from the chatter. It is set under the Settings tab of an email template in Settings > Technical > Email > Email Templates.

name: mail_layout_preview
summary: Lets you preview email templates in the browser as a full layout, outside the Odoo backend theme. Use the preview button on a template, choose the options, and open the full layout preview link. It is mainly for developers and template designers.

name: mail_message_search
summary: Adds a Message Search field to records with a chatter, so you can search the text of their conversations. It matches each word across subject, body, sender and reply-to. A system parameter can cap how many messages are searched on very large databases.

name: mail_no_user_assign_notification
summary: Stops the automatic email a user gets when they are assigned as responsible on certain records, such as Salesperson on contacts. You list the models to exclude in a system parameter. Only models that have a user field are affected.

name: mail_notification_clean_status_error
summary: Extends Odoo's scheduled cleanup so that failed email notifications are also deleted, not only successfully sent ones. This stops failed notifications from piling up and slowing down chatter queries. It runs automatically in the background.

name: mail_notification_custom_subject
summary: Lets you set a custom subject line for notification emails, using templates chosen by model and message subtype. Templates are created under Settings > Technical > Email > Subject Replacement Templates in debug mode. The subject is replaced when Odoo sends the email.

name: mail_optional_autofollow
summary: Adds a checkbox on the mail composer to decide whether new recipients are added as followers of the record. It starts ticked only when the action passes the right context. Use it to avoid unwanted followers on a message.

name: mail_optional_follower_notification
summary: Adds a checkbox in the mail composer to choose whether to notify the record's followers when sending a message. By default Odoo notifies everyone, so this lets you send a message quietly. Company settings also let administrators change the default.

name: mail_outbound_static
summary: Lets outgoing mail use a fixed From address chosen on the outgoing mail server, while keeping the real sender in the Sender header. A domain list decides when the original sender is kept. This is a technical email setting for compliance with email standards.

name: mail_partner_forwarding
summary: Lets a contact have a forwarding partner, a user who also receives all of that contact's notifications. For example, an assistant can be copied on an executive's messages. It is set on the contact form.

name: mail_partner_opt_out
summary: Adds a button next to partner email addresses to add them to the mass mailing blacklist, so they stop receiving campaign emails. Clicking the ban again removes the address from the blacklist. A Blacklisted filter lists all such contacts.

name: mail_post_defer
summary: Sends chatter messages through the outgoing mail queue, so they wait at least 30 seconds before going out. During that time the sender can delete the message and start again. This makes posting faster when the mail server is slow or there are many followers.

name: mail_quoted_reply
summary: Adds a Reply button on messages in the chatter, which opens a composer prefilled to reply to that message. It is useful for answering a customer's email directly from the thread. The reply appears in the same conversation.

name: mail_recipient_blocklist
summary: Blocks outgoing emails sent to certain recipients, using rules that match an exact address, a domain, text, a wildcard or a regular expression. Rules are managed under Settings > Technical > Email > Recipient Block Rules. Blocked emails are stopped before they leave the system.

name: mail_restrict_follower_selection
summary: Limits which contacts can be chosen as followers, for example only employees, using a domain set in system parameters. The limit can apply to all records or to one model. It also stops automatic adding of followers who do not match the domain.

name: mail_restrict_send_button
summary: Hides the Send message button in the chatter unless the user has the Show Send Message Button group. Use it to stop some users from emailing external contacts from record chatters. The group is assigned under the user's access rights.

name: mail_send_confirmation
summary: Asks the user to confirm before sending a message from the chatter composer, to avoid sending an internal message to external followers by mistake. It applies to the simple chatter composer only. The full composer is not affected.

name: mail_show_follower
summary: Shows the document's followers in the Cc line of emails sent from Odoo, when there is more than one. Internal users can be left out, and the text and format of the Sent to block can be set in General Settings under Mail. Users can also be excluded from the Cc line on their own profile.

name: mail_suggested_recipient_unchecked
summary: Unticks suggested recipients by default when a user writes a message in a chatter, such as a customer who is not yet a follower. The user must tick them to send the email to that person. This avoids sending to suggested contacts by accident.

name: mail_template_domain
summary: Lets an email template appear only for records that match a condition, such as only company contacts. Templates without a condition still show for every record of their model. The condition is set on the template under Restrict to in Settings > Technical > Email > Templates.

name: mail_template_substitute
summary: Lets one email template automatically replace another when conditions are met, such as sending a different template for a particular company. You add substitution rules on the template, each with a domain. It also works with the invoice sending wizard in Accounting.

name: mail_tracking
summary: Shows delivery status icons next to each recipient in the chatter for emails sent from Odoo, such as Waiting and Opened. It also adds failed-message lists and tracking records to the mail data. The Opened status depends on a tracking image in emails, which can be turned off with a system parameter.

name: mail_tracking_mailgun
summary: Connects email tracking to Mailgun, so the status in the chatter reflects real delivery results such as Received or Bounced. It can also check partner addresses against the Mailgun bounced list. Setup is in General Settings under Discuss, where you enter the Mailgun API details.

name: mail_tracking_mass_mailing
summary: Links mass mailing statistics with email tracking, so each mailing recipient shows its email status and tracking events. Contacts also get an email score to help clean up bad addresses in mailing lists. Mass mailing sends once per recipient, so duplicate the mailing to send it again.

name: outgoing_email_by_model
summary: Sets a specific outgoing mail server and sender address for a given model, such as sending all of one app's emails from a dedicated address. You fill in the fields on the model record under Settings > Technical > Models. It applies only to models that use the chatter.

name: base_maintenance
summary: Adds a team leader and a description to maintenance teams, a search view for teams, and a maintenance request report. It is a base module that other maintenance features build on. Requests also get an empty button area for other modules to fill.

name: base_maintenance_group
summary: Adds Maintenance user access groups, User and Full Access, so you can control who sees the Maintenance menus. Assign them under Settings > Users & Companies > Users in the Access Rights tab. The Equipment Manager group is listed in the same category.

name: hr_maintenance_security
summary: Stops HR users from getting the Equipment Manager maintenance role automatically, so HR staff do not gain maintenance access by default. The role can still be assigned manually. This is a technical security setting.

name: maintenance_account
summary: Creates equipment automatically when a vendor bill with a product marked Can be Maintenance is confirmed. A matching equipment category is created for the product, and a smart button shows the equipment created from the bill. It is found on Accounting vendor bills.

name: maintenance_equipment_category_hierarchy
summary: Lets equipment categories sit inside parent categories, so category names show their full path. Set the parent category on the equipment category form in Maintenance configuration. This gives a tree of categories instead of a flat list.

name: maintenance_equipment_contract
summary: Links maintenance equipment to supplier contracts, so each equipment shows its contracts and each contract lists its equipment. Equipment is added on the contract form in the Equipments field. The contract count is shown on the equipment.

name: maintenance_equipment_hierarchy
summary: Lets equipment be organized in a parent and child hierarchy, such as a machine with its parts underneath. Each equipment shows its child equipment and a count of them. It is set on the equipment form.

name: maintenance_equipment_ref
summary: Adds an Internal Reference field to maintenance equipment, for your own numbering or code. It appears on the equipment form.

name: maintenance_equipment_sequence
summary: Automatically numbers new equipment using a sequence set on each equipment category, with a prefix and next number. Equipment created in that category gets the next code. The sequence is set on the equipment category form.

name: maintenance_equipment_status
summary: Adds a Status field to equipment, with a list you define under Maintenance configuration. Statuses can be limited to certain equipment categories. The status is shown on the equipment form.

name: maintenance_equipment_tags
summary: Adds colored tags to maintenance equipment, so you can group or filter equipment by labels. Tags are managed in the maintenance configuration and assigned on the equipment form.

name: maintenance_equipment_usage
summary: Records who has used a piece of equipment, with pick up and return dates and states. Each equipment shows its usage history and whether it is currently in use. It is useful for tools or devices lent out to employees.

name: maintenance_helpdesk_mgmt
summary: Links helpdesk tickets to maintenance requests in both directions, so a support ticket can lead to or reference a repair job. Each side has a tab where you can link existing records or create new ones. It requires both the Helpdesk and Maintenance apps.

name: maintenance_location
summary: Adds a hierarchical location system for maintenance, with locations nested inside other locations. Equipment, plans and requests can be assigned a location, and locations can have a partner, coordinates and a sequence. Locations are managed in the maintenance configuration.

name: maintenance_partner
summary: Links equipment and maintenance requests to contacts. Equipment gets an assigned partner, and contacts get smart buttons showing their equipment and requests. This is useful when equipment belongs to or is serviced for a customer.

name: maintenance_plan
summary: Lets each equipment have several preventive maintenance plans, such as a monthly check and a yearly service, instead of only one. Plan kinds are defined in the maintenance configuration. Each plan has its own schedule and is found on the equipment's maintenance tab.

name: maintenance_plan_activity
summary: Lets a maintenance plan define activities, such as a checklist task, that are created along with each maintenance request the plan generates. Each activity has a responsible user and a number of days before the request date. These are set on the plan form.

name: maintenance_plan_only
summary: Hides Odoo's built-in recurring settings on maintenance requests, so users only see the maintenance plan scheduling. It is a technical module that avoids two competing recurrence options.

name: maintenance_product
summary: Links equipment to products and product categories, so new equipment can be created from a product. Equipment categories follow product categories automatically. Products are flagged with Can be Maintenance in their settings.

name: maintenance_project
summary: Adds projects and tasks to equipment and maintenance requests, so maintenance work can be tracked like other project work. Equipment can link to a project, and requests take the equipment's project by default, including preventive ones. It is mainly a technical base for timesheets on requests.

name: maintenance_purchase
summary: Creates equipment automatically when a purchase order is validated, using a category set on the product. Equipment links back to its purchase and purchase line, and purchase orders show a smart button for the equipment. It is found on purchase orders.

name: maintenance_request_employee
summary: Lets you assign employees to a maintenance request, so it is clear who will work on the job. Employees are picked on the request form. It requires the Employees app.

name: maintenance_request_purchase
summary: Links purchase orders to maintenance requests, so parts or services bought for a repair can be tracked on the request. Each request and each purchase order shows a smart button to its linked records. This is useful for repairs that need spare parts.

name: maintenance_request_repair
summary: Links maintenance requests to repair orders, so a repair order can be attached to a maintenance request. Each repair order shows its linked requests and a count. It requires the Repairs app.

name: maintenance_request_sequence
summary: Numbers maintenance requests automatically using a sequence on each maintenance team, with an optional team prefix. Each new request gets a reference code from that team's sequence. The prefix and sequence are set on the team form.

name: maintenance_request_tags
summary: Adds colored tags to maintenance requests so you can label and filter them. Tags are managed in the maintenance configuration and appear on the request form.

name: maintenance_security
summary: Limits the Maintenance menu to users who have one of the maintenance groups. It also stops the assignment email from being sent to users with no maintenance access, since it would contain a link they cannot open. This is a technical security module.

name: maintenance_stock
summary: Lets maintenance requests consume stock, such as spare parts taken from the warehouse. Each request has a Picking list button that creates stock transfers with their own sequence, from the equipment's default warehouse. Consumptions must be enabled on the equipment first.

name: maintenance_team_hierarchy
summary: Lets maintenance teams be nested under parent teams, and each team shows the requests of its sub teams. Counts of to-do requests are shown by date, high priority, blocked and unscheduled. The parent team is set on the team form.

name: maintenance_timesheet
summary: Lets people record timesheet hours on maintenance requests, and shows totals of hours spent, planned and remaining with a progress figure. Timesheets appear in the request's Timesheets tab. It requires the maintenance project and Timesheets modules.

name: maintenance_timesheet_time_control
summary: Adds start and stop timer buttons on maintenance requests for timesheet tracking, so a technician can run a timer while working. It follows the project timesheet time control, and the request needs a project set before the buttons show. This is a technical add-on.

name: account_partner_company_group
summary: Adds a Company Group field to customer invoices, so invoices can be found and reported by the customer's company group. It builds on the base company group feature. The field shows on the invoice form.

name: animal
summary: Stores information about animals, such as name, species, breed, color, size, weight, birth date and gender. Each animal can be linked to a species, breed and color. Animals are found under the Animals menu.

name: base_country_state_translatable
summary: Makes country state names translatable, so states can be shown in the user's language. This is a base module for localization modules, which add the translations for each country. It has no screens of its own.

name: base_location
summary: Lets you fill in a partner's city, state, country and zip automatically by entering a zip code. It uses zip records linked to cities, which you create under Contacts > Configuration > Localization. It also adds better search filters for locations.

name: base_location_geonames_import
summary: Imports cities and zip codes from the Geonames database for chosen countries. It is found under Contacts > Configuration > Localization > Import from Geonames. For each selected country, entries not found in the new download are removed before the import.

name: base_location_nuts
summary: Imports the European NUTS region list and adds NUTS level 1 to 4 fields to contacts. Regions can be marked Not updatable so the import does not overwrite or delete them. The import can be run from Contacts > Configuration > Localization.

name: base_partner_company_group
summary: Adds a Company Group field to companies, which is also passed on to their contacts, so contacts can be searched and grouped by company group. Leads, orders and invoices need the CRM, Sales or Accounting company group modules instead. This is the base module for company groups.

name: base_partner_merge_user_consolidation
summary: When merging duplicate contacts, also tidies up the user accounts linked to them. The most recently active user is kept and linked to the merged contact, and the others are archived with a changed login so they cannot sign in. It works from the Merge Contacts wizard.

name: base_partner_sequence
summary: Gives each new customer a reference code taken from a sequence, which is set as the default on new partners. The reference is managed on the company contact and copied to its contacts. Addresses such as delivery and invoice contacts do not get a reference.

name: crm_partner_company_group
summary: Adds a Company Group field to leads and opportunities in CRM, so pipeline records can be grouped by the customer's company group. It requires the base company group module.

name: partner_accreditation
summary: Lets you record accreditations or certifications on contacts, such as an official licence. Accreditations are kept as a managed list and tagged on each partner. They show on the contact form.

name: partner_address_split
summary: Adds helper methods that split a partner's address into a chosen number of street lines. It is useful in countries where street fields have length limits or printing constraints. This is a technical developer module with no visible screens.

name: partner_address_street3
summary: Adds a third street line to contact addresses. It shows on the contact form and in printed address formats. Useful when addresses need more lines.

name: partner_affiliate
summary: Adds an Affiliates tab on company contacts for holding companies and other group structures. The Contacts and Addresses tab then shows only the people linked to the company. The Affiliates tab appears only on company records.

name: partner_archive_propagate
summary: Adds an Archive Contact and Children button on company contacts, which also archives the child contacts after a confirmation list. Contacts linked to active users are skipped, and unarchiving propagates back. A setting can force this when archiving outside the screen, such as through imports or automated jobs.

name: partner_bank_acc_holder_name
summary: Shows the Account Holder Name field on bank account forms, which Odoo removed from the standard view. The data was already stored, so existing values reappear. It is set on the partner's bank account.

name: partner_bank_code
summary: Adds Bank Code and Bank Branch Code fields to banks, for banks that use these identifiers in payments. They are filled in under Contacts > Configuration > Bank Accounts > Bank.

name: partner_capital
summary: Records the capital of a company on its contact: the country the capital comes from, the registered capital amount, and a turnover range. Turnover ranges are managed under Contacts > Configuration. The fields are in the Sales & Purchases > Capital section.

name: partner_category_description
summary: Adds a Description field to contact tags, so you can explain what each tag means and when to use it. Descriptions are filled in when creating tags under Contacts > Configuration > Contact Tags.

name: partner_category_security
summary: Adds security groups for contact tags. Publishers can change the tags on contacts, and Managers can also create, edit and delete tags. The Contact Tags menu is shown only to Managers.

name: partner_category_type
summary: Adds a Type field to contact tags, so tags can be classified by type. Other modules can use this type to group tags or change how they behave. It appears on the contact tag form.

name: partner_company_default
summary: Sets a default company on contacts, so new contacts belong to the company you are working in. It is a base multi-company helper. It shows on the contact form.

name: partner_company_type
summary: Adds a Legal Form field to company contacts, chosen from a list of legal forms that each have a name and an abbreviation. Before this, the title field only applied to individuals, so this makes the company legal form available for companies.

name: partner_contact_access_link
summary: Adds a small button next to each sub-contact's name on a company form that opens that contact's full form. This saves navigating through Contacts to find a person. It works on any company that has sub-contacts.

name: partner_contact_address_default
summary: Lets each contact have a default delivery address, invoice address and contact person, which are picked on sales and invoice documents. An option lets you choose any partner rather than only child contacts. It is set on the contact form and in General Settings under Contact Category.

name: partner_contact_age_range
summary: Groups contacts into age ranges that you define, based on their computed age. A scheduled job keeps the ranges updated. Age ranges are set under Contacts > Configuration > Age Ranges.

name: partner_contact_birthdate
summary: Adds a Birthdate field to person contacts and computes their age from it. It is set on the contact's form when the contact is not a company. Age is updated automatically.

name: partner_contact_birthplace
summary: Adds birth city, zip, state and country fields to person contacts, in the Personal Information tab. It applies only to individuals, not companies.

name: partner_contact_department
summary: Adds a Department field to contacts, chosen from a list you maintain under Contacts > Configuration > Departments. It sits below the Job Position field on the contact form.

name: partner_contact_gender
summary: Adds a Gender field to person contacts with Male, Female and Other options. It is set on the Personal Information tab of the contact form.

name: partner_contact_job_position
summary: Adds a Categorized Job Position field to contacts, chosen from a list of job positions you maintain. The free-text job position is still available as well. Job positions are managed under Contacts > Configuration > Job Positions.

name: partner_contact_lang
summary: Improves contact language handling: a contact with no language takes its parent company's language, and changing a company's language fills it in for contacts that have none. You can also change a contact's language after creation, and search or group contacts by language.

name: partner_contact_nationality
summary: Adds a Nationality field to person contacts, in the Personal Information tab. It is a link to a list of nationalities.

name: partner_contact_personal_information_page
summary: Adds a Personal Information tab to contact forms, as a home for personal fields about people. On its own it adds no fields; it is the base that the birthdate, gender, nationality and birthplace modules build on. This is a technical base module.

name: partner_contact_role
summary: Lets a contact have one or more roles, such as a responsibility, on top of their job position. Roles are set on the contact form and managed under Sales > Configuration > Address Book > Partner Roles.

name: partner_contact_tags_in_popup
summary: Shows a contact's tags in the Contacts and Addresses pop-up form, so they can be seen without opening the full contact. It is a small display change with no new data.

name: partner_contact_type_end_user
summary: Adds an End User address type for partner addresses, used to record end customers linked to the ordering company. Pick it as the address type on a contact's address.

name: partner_country_lang
summary: Sets a language on each country, and that language is filled in automatically when a contact is given that country. For example, choosing France sets French on the contact. The country language is set under Contacts > Configuration > Countries.
